lines.text: LokalBot runs five AI models on your Mac. So how does one laptop hold them all?
It doesn't have to. The models are files on your disk, under ten gigabytes, and they take turns in memory.
During a call, LokalBot only records. Transcription waits until you hang up, and autocomplete pauses.
Then the speech models load, turn the sound into a transcript with speakers, and two minutes after they finish, they unload.
The language model comes in next and writes the notes. It stays ten minutes, in case you ask a follow-up, then leaves.
The autocomplete model stays loaded while there's room, because it answers every keystroke in about fifty milliseconds.
A broker budgets half your memory for loaded models, and what you're waiting for goes ahead of background work.
Five models, one Mac, taking turns.
LokalBot. Local by default, free and open source.
